       |                                                 |                                               |

       |                                                 |                                               |

       |                                                 |                                               |
       |<-------------------/ie1/leds--------------------|                                               |
       |                                                 |                                               |

       |                                                 |                                               |
       |                                                 |<----------/ie1/play chime key=<midi>----------|
       |                                                 |                                               |
       |<-------------------/ie1/play--------------------|                                               |
       |                                                 |                                               |

       |                                                 |                                               |
       |                                                 |-----------------/game/start------------------>|
       |                                                 |                                               |
[ request_start accepts; SETUP -> RUNNING; Room fixtures flash green x1 ]
       |                                                 |                                               |
       |-------------------/game/tilt------------------->|                                               |
       |                                                 |                                               |
       |                                                 |------------------/game/tilt------------------>|
       |                                                 |                                               |
       |                                                 |<-----/ie1/leds at = origin + cue_horizon------|
       |                                                 |                                               |
       |<-------------------/ie1/leds--------------------|                                               |
       |                                                 |                                               |
       |                                                 |<-----------------/ie1/release-----------------|
       |                                                 |                                               |
       |<------------------/ie1/release------------------|                                               |
       |                                                 |                                               |
+------------+                                       +------+                                       +---------+
| Tuneshroom |                                       | Arco |                                       | Control |
+------------+                                       +------+                                       +---------+
